notes: Random object record (kind 8, 16 or random; speed zero, negative zero, denormal, near or at the random hover limit, sometimes a sign-only high dword; max speed equal, near or random; heading -7..7, pitch -1.7..1.7), random frame ticks, tick seconds, hover limit, drift and accel scale. The real fcos/fsin helpers run; stubs log their arguments: 0x1dc20 logs the speed and sometimes overwrites it, 0x1debc logs position and speed, 0xb4364 logs the velocity vector and returns a random length, 0x1d8e8 returns a random AL.
